input.title: Frontend Engineering Intern
input.descriptionText:
Lumen Health is building a patient portal used by 200+ clinics. Join our web team for a 12-week paid internship ($32/hr).

You will build accessible, responsive UI components and help migrate legacy pages to our modern stack.

You must have:
- Experience building web apps with JavaScript and React
- Strong HTML and CSS fundamentals

Bonus points:
- TypeScript
- Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG)
- Testing with Jest or React Testing Library

We're empathetic to patients and to each other. We value attention to detail and inclusive design.

gold.summary: Paid frontend internship building accessible React UI components for a clinic patient portal.
